messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary failure for service=redwood-model-serving, deploy_id=deploy-2026-03-12-09, model_ref=mm-v2-2026-03-12. Canary 5/20 instances returning 500s or malformed outputs. Error rate 28% (> canary-threshold 5%). Tripped at 09:07 UTC.
mel (oncall-sre): Paging oncall. I'm taking it. Marking sev=2 for now. Any early customer reports?
laura (cs): Seeing 3 customers in the last 10m with "gibberish" completions and some 500s. Tickets 8871, 8872 reported via support.
mel (oncall-sre): ok. sam, can you pause rollout / kill flag for model mm-v2?
sam (infra): Running kill-switch: `redwood-ffctl set mm-v2-rollout false --env prod --reason "canary errors"`
ops-deploy-bot: Rollout flag mm-v2-rollout set to false by sam. Canary traffic will be removed from mm-v2 within ~30s.
mel (oncall-sre): Confirming canary traffic reduction in metrics. Error rate dropping on canaries but still seeing degraded outputs on some nodes.
jia (ml-eng): Joining — saw the error traces. Quick guess: tokenizer mismatch between saved model artifact and serving config. Logs show tokenizer.load() complaining about unknown tokens and then falling back to byte encoding. That would explain garbled outputs. Also checksum of weights doesn't match model registry entry.
mel (oncall-sre): omg. Are we sure it's the published artifact?
jia (ml-eng): Looking at artifact metadata: `model_registry.get('mm-v2-2026-03-12').artifact_id = a1b2c3` but node shows `artifact_id = a1b2c3-staging` and weights checksum `sha256:deadbeef` vs expected `sha256:beefdead`. Looks like a config drift / wrong artifact tag used in deploy manifest.
sam (infra): Will start immediate rollback to previous stable revision v1.9.7. Command: `redwood-deploy rollback --service model-serving --to mm-v1.9.7 --reason "mm-v2 canary failure"`
ops-deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by sam. Rolling back canaries first, then workers. Estimated completion 10m.
mel (oncall-sre): Noting customer impact: some API requests returned 500, many returned low-quality outputs. CS is triaging top customer tickets. Prioritizing rollback > hotfix.
laura (cs): Sending proactive comms to affected customers: template drafted. Will attach sample outputs and offer session with solutions engineer.
kai (product): Any data loss? Are embeddings/metadata affected?
jia (ml-eng): No data loss. It's inference-time only. No persisted artifacts mutated. Issue: deploy manifest referenced `tokenizer:bpe-v1` but artifact packaged `tokenizer:byte-level`. The model runtime accepted it but produced nonsense for many prompts. Also weights mismatch likely because CI push used stale tag.
mel (oncall-sre): Good catch. After rollback, we need postmortem + checklist to validate artifact metadata vs manifest before rollout.
sam (infra): Rollback completed at 09:21 UTC. Canary error rate back to baseline, global traffic moved to mm-v1.9.7.
ops-bot: Notice: Service latency and error-rate alarms cleared at 09:25 UTC.
mel (oncall-sre): Running sanity checks: sample queries against mm-v1.9.7 OK. Confirming customer-facing endpoints healthy.
laura (cs): Notifying customers that we rolled back and are investigating root cause. Will share ETA for resolution.
jia (ml-eng): Root cause summary so far: deployment pipeline used an incorrect artifact tag (staging alias) and a mismatched tokenizer config in deploy manifest. Result: tokenizer fallback -> garbled outputs; weights checksum mismatch indicates artifact tagging error.
mel (oncall-sre): Mitigations taken: 1) killed rollout via feature flag 2) rolled back to stable version 3) blocked mm-v2 artifact tag in registry pending verification 4) alerted release owner to pause further mm-v2 deploys.
sam (infra): Added guard in deploy pipeline: require artifact checksum verification step `check-artifact --expected-sha $SHA --artifact $ID` and fail if mismatch. Will PR in 30m.
kai (product): We need a customer-facing postmortem and internal RCA. Priority: confirm scope (#customers impacted), duration, and next steps.
mel (oncall-sre): Handing off to jia for next ops window. I'll create incident doc and start timeline. Oncall handoff: mel -> jia, taking over at 09:40 UTC.
jia (ml-eng): Acknowledged. I'll do deeper forensic: CI logs, registry push events, and who merged the release. Tagging release owner @tommy in the follow-up.
laura (cs): I'll follow up with customers after we have the timeline. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Severity: SEV-2. Created incident ticket INC-2026-0312-9.
mel (oncall-sre): Closing incident channel for active mitigation. Will fill postmortem template and include action items (artifact tagging policy, pre-deploy artifact validation, feature-flag kill-switch dry runs).
jia (ml-eng): Action items assigned: investigate how tokenizer metadata omitted from packaged artifact (investigate build script), add pre-deploy tokenizer-config validation, and add an automated checksum gate.
laura (cs): Please loop me when postmortem is ready so I can send customer communication.
mel (oncall-sre): Thanks all. If anything new pops up re-open thread. :heart:
